description: A Java Android activity class that demonstrates the use of QuickContactBadge and contacts content provider to display a list of contacts with quick contact badges.

classes.name: QuickContactsDemo
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity, displaying contacts with quick contact badges.

classes.name: ContactListItemCache
classes.description: Cache object for holding view components related to a contact list item, including TextView and QuickContactBadge.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, queries contacts, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds data from the cursor to the view components for each list item.

methods.name: newView
methods.description: Creates a new list item view and associated cache.
